name: Treant's Call
prerequisites: Cha 17, ability to cast speak with plants, character level 13th, gathlain
benefit: You can cast liveoak once per day as a spell-like ability, but its duration is only 10 minutes.
flavor: You have learned some words of the mystic language treants use to call trees to their defense.
